dialogues.jp: 「……ん、もう暗くなってきたのか」

空を見上げる。薄青い闇の中で、月が｛こうこう／煌々｝と輝
いていた。
dialogues.en:
I looked up at the sky. In the pale blue darkness, the moon
was shining brightly.
dialogues.text:
I looked up at the sky. In the pale blue darkness, the moon
was shining brightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、来るのが遅かったからね」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことり、凝り過ぎ。あんまり待たせるから、
　新手のイジメかと思ったぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Kotori, you didn't need to spend so much time on lunch. By
the time you finished, we could've done a lot already."
dialogues.text:
"Kotori, you didn't need to spend so much time on lunch. By
the time you finished, we could've done a lot already."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごめん。でも、美味しかったでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry. But it was good, wasn't it?"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry. But it was good, wasn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。味は最高だった」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なら、いいよね」

この前約束したように、今日は、花見にやって
来ていた。
dialogues.en:
As we promised earlier in the week, today, we went
flower-viewing.
dialogues.text:
As we promised earlier in the week, today, we went
flower-viewing.

dialogues.jp:
来るのが午後も遅い時間になってしまったのだ
が、それは、ことりが長々と弁当を作っていた
せいだ。
dialogues.en:
We only arrived late in the afternoon, due to Kotori's
endless preparations for our lunchboxes.
dialogues.text:
We only arrived late in the afternoon, due to Kotori's
endless preparations for our lunchboxes.

dialogues.jp:
「いや〜、でも、確かに美味かった。あの焼き
　魚なんて、特に気に入ったな」
dialogues.en:
"Nooo~, but it really was great. The fried fish in
particular was amazing."
dialogues.text:
"Nooo~, but it really was great. The fried fish in
particular was amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それに、あの豚汁もいいダシが出てたぞ」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ポトフの事？」
dialogues.en:
"And the soup stock used to make the pork soup was great as
well."
dialogues.text:
"And the soup stock used to make the pork soup was great as
well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「一番気に入ったのが、牛のたたきだな。あれ
　はいいものだ」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……カルパッチョ」
dialogues.en:
"But the best were those slices of beef. They had a flavour
to die for."
dialogues.text:
"But the best were those slices of beef. They had a flavour
to die for."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、名前なんてどうでもいいよな」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、美味しいって言ってくれたから、許し
　てあげるよ」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、そろそろ帰ろうか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, you said they were good, so I'd let you off this
time."
dialogues.text:
"Well, you said they were good, so I'd let you off this
time."

dialogues.jp:
普通に帰るのなら、ここで別れなければならな
いが、さて……。
どうしようかな……
dialogues.en: I stood up from the bench with much vigor.
dialogues.text: I stood up from the bench with much vigor.

dialogues.jp: ◆誘う？◆
約束どおり桜公園に花見に来た俺とことり。

楽しい時間は過ぎるのが早いもので、気がつけ
ばもう夜。

帰ろうと公園の出口までやって来たが、もっと
ことりと一緒にいたい気もする。
さて……。
dialogues.en: It was later than usual, but what should I do...
dialogues.text: It was later than usual, but what should I do...

choices.en: 〇We reached the exit of the park without much incident.
choices.text: 〇We reached the exit of the park without much incident.

choices.jp: 〇もう少しデートを楽しむ
choices.en:
〇When we normally head home, this is where we would part,
now...
choices.text:
〇When we normally head home, this is where we would part,
now...
